segments.caption: A brown bear is perched high in a leafy tree, actively foraging by tearing at and eating the green, catkin-like blossoms. It uses its paws to grip branches and pull down clusters of flowers, occasionally looking around its surroundings before returning to its meal. The tree is situated in an urban or semi-urban environment, with a multi-story building visible in the background, highlighting the unusual juxtaposition of wildlife in a developed area.

A brown bear is perched high in a tree with fresh green blossoms, actively foraging. It uses its paws to grip branches and pull at the foliage, occasionally opening its mouth as if eating or sniffing the blossoms. The scene is set against a backdrop of urban buildings, highlighting the bear's presence in a semi-urban environment.

A brown bear is perched high in a leafy tree, actively feeding on the fresh green blossoms. It uses its paws to grasp branches and pull down clusters of buds to eat, occasionally shifting its position to reach different areas. The tree is situated in an urban environment, with a multi-story building visible in the background, highlighting the unusual setting for this wild animal.

A brown bear is seen climbing and maneuvering through the branches of a leafy tree, with a building and a river visible in the background. The bear appears to be foraging or exploring, moving deliberately among the branches and occasionally looking around.

A brown bear is seen climbing and maneuvering through the branches of a leafy tree near a river, with a second bear visible nearby, suggesting a family group engaging in natural foraging or play behavior in a semi-urban environment.
Several young brown bears are seen climbing and moving around a tree near a body of water, with spectators watching from a nearby viewing platform.
Two young brown bears climb down a tree by a river, watched by people on a bridge, before reaching the ground and playfully interacting near the base of the tree.
Two young brown bears playfully interact near a tree before walking away together across a grassy, wooded area.
